[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pre-baking (pre-bake crust for 2-3 minutes before adding toppings).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Topping balance (avoid too many toppings to prevent sogginess).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Cooking time and temperature (cook for 10-12 minutes until golden brown).
